description: Create a new agent: on the workspace's mails.ai address (`name`), or at an address on a domain the workspace has verified (`address`), with `forwarding: true` when the mail service that already hosts that address forwards its mail to the agent. Returns the agent, with its forwarding_address and forwarding_status in forwarding mode.

address.description: The agent's address, on a domain the workspace has verified for sending (support@acme.com). The agent is named after its local part.

allowlist_domains.description: When set, this agent sends only to these domains and their subdomains; any other recipient in to, cc or bcc refuses the send (422 recipient_not_allowed), test keys included.

blocklist_domains.description: Domains (and their subdomains) this agent never sends to (422 recipient_not_allowed).

classify_inbound.description: Also read this agent's new mail for intent, entities and urgency (never a reply in a thread). Needs a paid plan (402 `feature_not_enabled`). Off unless set. Its `message.received` events then carry an `intent`, `entities` and `urgency`, and on `reply.received` the `intent` is always `general_reply`. The injection scan runs either way.

daily_send_limit.description: The most recipients this agent's live sends reach in any 24 hours (each `to`, `cc` and `bcc` address once), on top of the plan's cap; past it a send gets 429 daily_limit_exceeded. Leave it out to use only the plan's cap.

forwarding.description: Forwarding mode: the mail service that already hosts `address` forwards its mail to the agent's forwarding_address, so no MX record changes. mails_agents_verify_forwarding tests the forward.

hourly_send_limit.description: The most recipients this agent's live sends reach in any hour (each `to`, `cc` and `bcc` address once), on top of the plan's cap; past it a send gets 429 hourly_limit_exceeded. Leave it out to use only the plan's cap.

name: mails_create_agent
title: Create an agent
